name: Large Pool 调优 — 配置与使用场景
description: Large Pool 是 SGA 中独立于 Shared Pool 的可选区域。用于 Shared Server 会话内存、RMAN I/O 缓冲、并行消息缓冲。未配置时这些操作从 Shared Pool 分配可能导致 ORA-04031。

root_causes.name: Large Pool 未配置或过小
RMAN 备份期间不足
root_causes.desc: 多通道备份需要大量缓冲区。

root_causes.name: Shared Server 会话过多
root_causes.desc: MTS 模式 UGA 从 Large Pool 分配。

step1_check_size.sql: SELECT pool, name, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024,1) mb FROM v$sgastat WHERE pool = 'large pool' ORDER BY bytes DESC

step2_check_config.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('large_pool_size','shared_servers','parallel_max_servers')
